description: Suscetibilidade à desertificação is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto da Conservação da Natureza e das Florestas, I. P - ICNF. Division of the territory into areas susceptible and not susceptible to desertification, defined by spatialisation and simplification of the aridity index, which expresses the ratio between annual precipitation and potential annual evapotranspiration. Coverage: Instituto da Conservação da Natureza e das Florestas, I. P - ICNF. The portal shows the English title as "Susceptibility to desertification" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Instituto da Conservação da Natureza e das Florestas, I. P - ICNF. Its keywords include suscetibilidade-do-territorio, infomapaccessservice, caracteristicas-geometeorologicas, aridez, cartografia-oficial, planos-de-desenvolvimento-regional. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
